label: combinatorics
tail:
Done. The lane resumed from its own checkpoint and ran to completion.

## What I found on arrival

A previous instance of this lane had been cut off by the session limit after writing §18–§22 (reconciliation, placement findings, well-definedness rows, choice ledger, and the 13-pair enumerative block). Its checkpoint at §17bis named the exact next action. I continued from there rather than restarting.

## What I added

**Four new blocks — 38 new A/B pairs, bringing the file to 51 pairs (102 pages):**

- **§23** algebraic, spectral and design — 8 pairs (linear-algebra methods, the Combinatorial Nullstellensatz, Frankl–Wilson/Borsuk, designs, projective planes, codes and association schemes, two spectral graph-theory pages)
- **§24** graph theory — 18 pairs (the four-page colouring split, connectivity structure, treewidth, matching II, three matroid pages, the Tutte polynomial and flows, regularity/Roth, the Rado graph, expansion, and three pages placed above the planarity page)
- **§25** probabilistic, Ramsey and additive — 12 pairs (entropy, correlation/Janson, martingales, discrepancy, Ramsey II, quasirandomness, finite Fourier/Roth, cap sets, sumsets, sum–product)
- **§26–§29** — the coverage harvest with dispositions, the build frontier, 14 amendments owed, and 14 blockers; **§17** is the orchestrator summary, at the top.

I dispatched three research subagents for gaps the wave-1 harvests had left open. All three closed: matroids had no source at all; the Tutte polynomial was genuinely absent from Diestel; and the graph harvest's own §C.13 — promising Shannon's bound, Tutte–Berge and full Gallai–Edmonds — **had never been written**.

## Three corrections to the file's existing content

1. **§19.2 F2 was wrong.** It reported the library has no cofactor expansion or adjugate, having read `determinants-of-matrices-over-a-commutative-ring`. They're all published — on `the-determinant-of-a-linear-operator`, the *next* page. Only Cauchy–Binet is genuinely absent. An amendment to the algebra track is cancelled.
2. **§19.1's "one pair above the planarity page" is superseded** — Kuratowski–Wagner and plane duality turn out to be published, so what remains above needs three pairs, not one.
3. **§20 row #83 demanded a proof of something free** and missed the real obligation. I also reconciled 17 stale `§n` cross-references left by the earlier numbering.

## Two things worth your attention

**A denial recorded before the sources were read is a hypothesis.** Three of them fell this run: §11's Frankl–Wilson denial (Babai–Frankl's own preface certifies a self-contained proof), §11's CB-10 premise (Burnside's lemma is published), and the Tutte basis-activity expansion, rated `[C]` by one harvest and `[B]` by a better-sourced one.

**One seam needs your ruling, and it's the expensive kind.** Three pages need `def-character-of-a-finite-abelian-group`. For an abelian group it's five steps from published roots-of-unity material — but SEAMS §4 arguably puts "characters" inside `abstract-algebra`'s representation-theory remit. §28 A10 states the scaffold's proposal; an id minted twice is the worst failure this commission can produce, so I didn't decide it alone.

I wrote only `research/plan-combinatorics-and-categories.md` plus the harvest artifacts this lane commissioned. No item, page, spec entry or `status:` field was touched, and no permission was requested by this lane or any of its seven subagents.
